description: Refine the sentence structure and style of the documents: shorten long sentences, replace cumbersome nominal constructions with verbs, make enumerations parallel, strike filler words and redundancy, fix awkward transitions, and adjust voice, while content, numbers, and technical terms stay exactly as they are.
